name: Mirabell
beschreibung: The Gasthof Mirabell is located in the village center of Söll at the foot of the mountains. The surroundings are characterized by their proximity to the ski slopes of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser. The house offers rooms with bathroom, TV and Wi-Fi. The interior of the house is kept in a traditional style. The atmosphere is geared toward an uncomplicated stay. The main target group is hikers and skiers. The restaurant serves regional cuisine and Tiroler Spezialitäten. On request, half board is offered.
